title: Reliable Senior Developer Needed - On-Call Maintenance Retainer (Web App)

feed.title: Reliable Senior Developer Needed - On-Call Maintenance Retainer (Web App)
feed.description:
Looking for a dependable senior developer for an ongoing maintenance retainer (not full-time): when something breaks on our custom-built photo editor app, we need someone we can reach who fixes it fast  and who can also implement improvements as we request them over time.

Right now our editor runs on a third-party SaaS: costly, and we have zero control over it  no way to adapt it to our needs. So we're building our own in-house editor to get off it. The developer building it is handling initial development only  he won't be taking on maintenance afterward.

We're looking for a senior developer to take over ongoing maintenance and continuous improvement of this editor, on a maintenance retainer (not full-time volume varies based on needs).

Stack: Bun backend, React frontend (fully responsive, mobile-heavy traffic), Shopify (theme dev, Storefront/Admin API).

What you'll do:
- Pick up a codebase you didn't write and get up to speed fast
- Respond quickly when something's reported (bug, blocker, outage) same-day fixes
- Solve problems autonomously, without technical supervision
- Implement requested features/improvements over time
- Manage and maintain the connections with our Shopify back office

You're a fit if you have:
Senior-level experience with production web apps
Proven experience with e-commerce/Shopify integrations
A track record of taking over and maintaining legacy/existing code
A reputation for being responsive, reliable, and autonomous
Solid written English (we work async, in writing)

Contract type: Ongoing maintenance retainer not full-time. You're called on when something breaks or an evolution is requested.

questions.question: 1. Have you maintained a production web app that real users depend on every day? Which one, and for how long?
2. Have you worked with Shopify before (theme development, Storefront or Admin API)? What did you build?
3. Have you ever taken over a codebase you didn't write? How did you get up to speed?
4. If something breaks on a Saturday, how fast can you realistically respond?
5. What is your timezone, and what monthly retainer would you expect for this kind of role?

pastJobsText.title: Influence marketing manager for Travel Brand
pastJobsText.description: About Souvence Souvence is a premium travel photobook brand, mixing aesthetics, nostalgia, and the joy of travel memories. We are disrupting an old-fashioned industry with a modern, emotional, and international approach. Role We’re looking for an Influence Marketing Manager to run our influencer program: - Find & contact travel influencers (IG/TikTok) - Negotiate & close collaborations - Manage contracts, gift cards & campaign tracking (Airtable/Sheets) - Follow up, collect content & report performance What We’re Looking For - 2+ years of experience in influencer marketing / social media management - Strong outreach, negotiation, and organization skills - Comfortable with Airtable/Google Sheets & tracking links - Excellent written English - Autonomous, serious, motivated, and passionate about social media & travel Why Join Souvence? ✨ Work with a young, creative, international brand ✨ Be trusted with full ownership and autonomy ✨ Collaborate in a 100% remote, process-driven team ✨ Contribute to scaling a brand that touches people’s most emotional memories: their travels Apply now with a short intro + examples of campaigns you’ve managed.
